summary:
AstroScout AI is a hybrid artificial intelligence system developed for NASA Space Apps Challenge 9. It aims to find the most accurate geological environments on Earth that simulate Martian and Lunar terrains.
​The core idea goes beyond mere visual similarity by building a cloud-based engine that relies on three technical pillars:
​Data Engineering: Sanitizing and standardizing NASA maps into true-color, noise-free, nadir (satellite) views.
​Hybrid AI: Integrating three advanced computer vision models (ResNet-50, VGG-16, MobileNetV2) to deeply analyze terrain roughness and spatial patterns.
​Geochemical Reranking: Applying a mathematical algorithm that balances AI topographical similarity with chemical color signatures, ensuring the actual geological makeup (like iron or basalt) matches.
​The ultimate goal is to provide NASA with highly reliable data to pinpoint exact, safe simulation sites. These locations are crucial for training astronauts and testing rovers before space missions launch, significantly minimizing risks and ensuring mission success.
details:
The Problem:
Testing rovers and training astronauts for extraterrestrial missions requires highly accurate simulation sites on Earth. Relying on basic visual similarities often leads to selecting terrains with the wrong geochemical makeup or structural hazards.

Our Solution (AstroScout AI / GEO-MATCH):
We built a robust, cloud-deployed AI engine that doesn't just look at shapes, but analyzes the deep geological footprint of space terrains. Our solution is divided into three main pillars:
1. Data-Centric AI (Sanitization & Standardization): We prioritized clean data over complex generic models. We calibrated Mars/Moon inputs to true-color, nadir (satellite) views, and stripped text noise.
2. Hybrid Ensemble Architecture: We deployed a decentralized Cloud API on Hugging Face using three specific models: ResNet-50 (60% weight for topographical roughness), VGG-16 (20% for spatial patterns), and MobileNetV2 (20% for rapid feature extraction). We also integrated Gemini for intelligent data interpretation.
3. Mathematical Geochemical Reranking: To prevent "Texture Dominance", we developed a dual-evaluation algorithm. We extract the deep AI feature vector (Cosine Similarity) and penalize it using a mathematical color signature (Euclidean Distance of RGB mean/std) representing chemical makeup (e.g., Iron=Red, Basalt=Dark Gray).

Result:
A highly accurate matched Earth analog (like Jezero Crater to Atacama Desert), stored and retrieved instantly via a Supabase backend.
